extractor: read directly from the official INZ page listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: The visa-waiver country list and the NZeTA-eligible country list. INZ links both rather than stating them on this page, and neither linked page is a registered source. Reproducing a country list from memory is exactly what the provenance rule forbids.
The 'acceptable sponsor' criteria. Linked to a separate page ('who can sponsor a visa applicant') that is not registered.
The single- versus multiple-entry distinction and its 18-month calculation. Stated on the page but decided by INZ per application, so it is not an applicant requirement.
Processing times (80% within 2 weeks). A service statistic, not a requirement, and it moves independently of the rules.
The situations requiring an x-ray or medical examination, and the tuberculosis-incidence country list — both are separate linked pages.

requirements.label: May be asked for a chest x-ray, a medical examination, or both
requirements.description: INZ frames this as something it MAY require, not a universal step, so it is not recorded as officially required.
requirements.source_excerpt: we may ask you to have a chest x-ray, a medical examination or both as proof of your health.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: We may ask you to have a chest X-ray, a medical examination or both as proof of your health.

requirements.label: Health evidence thresholds by length of stay
requirements.description: No rule attached. The sentence sets two different thresholds for two different documents and says 'not normally' for both; encoding that as a boolean gate would turn a soft default into a hard answer.
requirements.source_excerpt: if you are staying less than: 6 months, you do not normally need a chest x-ray 12 months, you do not normally need a medical certificate.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you are staying less than: 6 months, you do not normally need a chest X-ray 12 months, you do not normally need a medical certificate.

requirements.label: Police certificates less than 6 months old
requirements.description: INZ's second condition is a total stay of 24 months or longer, encoded here as 730 days because the rule engine compares days. Rarely reached on this visa, whose maximum stay is 9 months, but it applies when earlier time in New Zealand is counted.
requirements.source_excerpt: you must provide police certificates that are less than 6 months old when you apply, if: you are aged 17 or older, and
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must provide police certificates that are less than 6 months old when you apply, if: you are aged 17 or older, and

requirements.label: A criminal conviction or security risk may prevent a visa
requirements.description: Recorded so a conviction is never presented to a user as automatically disqualifying — INZ says 'might not'.
requirements.source_excerpt: if you have a criminal conviction, or are a security risk to new zealand, we might not give you a visa.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you have a criminal conviction, or are a security risk to New Zealand, we might not give you a visa.

requirements.label: Hold at least NZD $1,000 per month, or NZD $400 if accommodation is pre-paid
requirements.description: Applies when the applicant funds the stay themselves; an acceptable sponsor is the alternative.

requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you are paying for yourself You must have at least NZD $1,000 a month, or NZD $400 a month if you have already paid for your accommodation.
